remarks:
A rare opportunity to own one of Western New York’s most iconic waterfront estates. This historic Tudor, originally built in the early 1900s, is privately nestled on 4+ acres of spectacular grounds with approximately 400 feet of frontage along the West River, offering breathtaking water views, mature landscaping, and an unmatched lifestyle.

The estate combines timeless architecture with exceptional amenities. The main residence features 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths/ 2 half baths, grand entertaining spaces, and remarkable craftsmanship throughout, including stone Tudor detailing, rich woodwork, and panoramic views from nearly every rear-facing room. The kitchen is appointed with leathered granite countertops, premium stainless-steel appliances a walk-in-pantry complemented by a quaint eating area.

Designed for entertaining, the home offers a grand formal dining room, billiard room, private office/man cave, and a truly one-of-a-kind bowling alley in the lower level. 

All bedrooms are located on the second floor. The primary bedroom features a fireplace, sitting area and 2 separate bathrooms- each uniquely designed with luxurious closet space with custom built-ins.

Step outside to experience resort-style living with a 60FT swimming pool, pool house with full bath, manicured gardens, rolling lawns, and a private dock capable of accommodating a 36-foot boat. The separate guest house provides exceptional flexibility with 3 bedrooms, a full kitchen, living area, and attached one-car garage, ideal for extended family, guests, or caretakers. Completing the estate is a three-car garage and expansive grounds that create an extraordinary sense of privacy and tranquility. 2 gas wells with gas rights are included. 

Steeped in history and thoughtfully maintained, this is a legacy property where timeless elegance meets unparalleled waterfront living. An offering of this caliber is exceptionally rare. Private appointments available with 24hour notice for prequalified buyers.
